changeSet.author: nexus-e8h5x
changeSet.comment: nexus.gc_restore_rereferenced_bounded: restore at most p_row_limit re-referenced chunks out of quarantine per call, carry created_at through, audit the batch, and return (restored, remaining) so a caller can loop and terminate. One call is one commit. The unbounded gc_restore_rereferenced is left untouched for the indexer's small incremental restore. DATA EFFECT: none -- this changeset only creates a function and grants EXECUTE on it.
changeSet.rollback: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.gc_restore_rereferenced_bounded(int, text, text, text, int);
